Seen • Just now
Yes — damaged items are handled differently from normal returns.
Normal returns: Once an order has been delivered, returns are generally not accepted for change of mind or taste. 
Damaged items: These are treated as a shipment issue. You can report the problem within 7 days of delivery and provide:
• A photo of the damaged item
• A photo of the packaging or packing slip
• A short description of the issue
The photos help verify what happened and allow the case to be reviewed for a possible resolution.
So in short: regular returns are limited after delivery, but damaged or incorrect items can be reported for review within 7 days with photos.
